name: DAPH_PROGRESS_EXECUTIVE_V1

architecture.description: External causal metacognitive layer that estimates which actions are worth considering, avoids false precision, and selectively biases a strong base policy.
architecture.pipeline: Legal(s) -> Q_causal(s,a) -> A_epsilon(s) -> Progress(s,a) -> LLM policy
components: Q_CAUSAL_V1: frozen gradient-boosted causal action-value estimator
I2: epsilon near-optimal set interface (epsilon_q=3.0), categorical output
architecture.design_principle: An external causal metacognitive layer estimates which actions are worth considering, avoids false precision, and selectively biases a strong base policy. It is NOT a symbolic controller that decides what the model must do.

causal_Q_vs_no_guidance.detail: V1 moves success from 73.3% to 87.2% and utility from 47.21 to 70.75 on hostile unseen benchmark. Delta_U(V1-C0)=+23.54, CI=[+14.98, +32.82], excludes 0. 25 rescues, 0 breaks, McNemar p<0.0001.

causal_Q_vs_B0.detail: V1 beats global-prior baseline. Delta_U(V1-B0)=+26.21, CI=[+17.31, +35.72], excludes 0. 27 rescues, 0 breaks, McNemar p<0.0001. The simple heuristic cannot explain the gain.

I2_uncertainty_respecting_interface.detail: I2 passes a categorical near-optimal set rather than scalar Q values. This prevents numerical pseudo-precision from corrupting Qwen's native policy. The interface was frozen before confirmation and never modified.

progress_as_local_tie_break.evidence: Mechanistically supported; incremental global advantage over V1 not yet statistically established
progress_as_local_tie_break.detail: VP rescues 2 V1 failures on chain tasks with 0 breaks. Both rescues occur by removing a redundant RETRIEVE, preserving budget to reach ANSWER. However, Delta_U(VP-V1)=+1.14 with CI=[+0.00, +2.85] which includes 0, and McNemar p=0.50 for 2 rescues/0 breaks. Progress did not degrade the confirmed executive and has specific mechanistically consistent rescue cases, but statistical superiority over V1 is not established.

Q_V2_history_model.detail: Phase 22 temporal audit found Q(s,RETRIEVE) remains flat at 93.53 across retrieval depths 0,1,2 for ol_retrieve states. Only 3/11 category/action pairs showed meaningful effects (27.3%, below 30% threshold). V2 is rejected for current evidence, not permanently. Only revisit if confirmation exposes a failure Progress cannot solve.

confirmation_results.benchmark: 180 hostile tasks, 15 subtypes, tight budgets (3-8 steps, 0-2 retrievals, 1-3 verifications, 0-1 searches)

frozen_components.i2_interface: categorical near-optimal set — no modification permitted

prohibition: No changes to Q model, epsilon, progress rule, prompt representation, utility, executor, or phase/state computation. The system is frozen. The next question is generalization, not optimization.
defensible_claim: On a preregistered hostile unseen benchmark, a frozen causal metacognitive executive improved a pinned Qwen policy from 73.3% to 88.3% success, producing 27 rescues and zero breaks relative to the unguided baseline while also outperforming a strong global-prior control.

next_research_program.question: How broadly does the confirmed architecture generalize?
next_research_program.priority_1: Cross-seed benchmark replication — new untouched benchmark from same task family with completely new seed. Run C0, B0, V1, VP only.
next_research_program.priority_2: Cross-model replication — freeze DAPH completely, swap policy model to Gemma (and possibly Llama). Same controller, no refitting. Tests metacognitive structure vs Qwen-specific quirks.
next_research_program.priority_3: Cross-domain tasks — translate action vocabulary to coding/research/tool-use (READ, SEARCH_CODE, RUN_TEST, PATCH, VERIFY, ANSWER/STOP or SEARCH_WEB, RETRIEVE_SOURCE, CROSS_CHECK, CALCULATE, ANSWER, DEFER). Tests whether state, causal value, epsilon-set, and progress generalize beyond evidence verification.
